items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 9:1
items.html: (To the question) There are two aspects in the renewal of the old souls: one is from the aspect of the illumination of vessels, to return to them the aspect of AHP, to complete them in ten vessels, and this is done through the coupling of the night, and this is discerned as the renewal of the souls, like the example of the vessel in it, namely, just as the vessel and spirit that were renewed for the Nukva, so the souls are renewed from this aspect. And there is an aspect of the renewal of souls literally, namely, from the aspect of the Mochin of the new MAH, and this is done in the coupling of the day. (Item 17).
